root_cause: Database connectivity failure caused by unreachable orders-db leading to connection timeouts
evidence: Distributed trace trace-db-timeout-901 indicates database call timed out after 5000ms deadline exceeded
HTTP 500 error rate spiked to 24.2% on /simulate/error endpoint
contradictory_evidence: CPU utilization remained normal at 24.0% ruling out CPU exhaustion
Memory utilization remained stable at 39.5% ruling out out-of-memory crash
No new revision deployed prior to the incident (revision deployed 4+ hours earlier)
blast_radius: Scope: service-wide affecting checkout-service on /simulate/error. Region: regional (us-central1).
recommended_action: Check network connectivity, VPC connector status, and health of the orders-db database instance
additional_checks_required: Verify Cloud SQL or external database instance CPU and storage metrics
Inspect VPC firewall rules and Serverless VPC Access connector health
